children.text: Mode colours, written back from #693/#714 (owner calls, 2026-08-20): mute reads GREEN on every surface — $success over the $success-surface wash on the chrome pills (stage status bar and desktop ModeIndicator; the DS indicator specimen 'mode pill / mute' records the variant, and the screens keep drawing the nominal REC state), $led-green on the 7″ readout and on the pedal's MODE LED. Rec is red everywhere: the pedal's LED moved rec green → red in the same stroke, because mute could not simply take green while rec held it — that would make the pedal's two BOOT modes (record and mute) indistinguishable on the one indicator whose job is naming them. FX stays blue. The desktop ModeIndicator's REC arm reads $rec #e5484d, the chrome red the pills draw — not $signal-rec #ff1744, the stage record hue. The pedal plate itself is not drawn in this file, so its two calls are recorded here: (1) the MODE LED is SOLID in every state and reports the interaction mode only — the performance-armed BLINK is gone, because armed already shows on both screens (the stage bar's pill and the 7″ readout's REC pill with running elapsed) and a blinking red was only distinguishable from a solid red by watching a full half-period; do not reintroduce it on the next pass at the pedal. (2) the ring's idle sweep is a dim neutral $ring-glow in every mode, never a dimmed mode tint — a dim red idle ring in rec mode reads as a live take from stage distance; red on the ring means recording activity, exclusively.
